Personality: Peric is a quintessential Vlandian technocratic lord, standing in stark contrast to his notoriously brutal clan leader, Hecard. Reserved in nature and exceedingly cautious, he often appears timid and hesitant on the battlefield, preferring to resolve problems through meticulous engineering calculations and logistical coordination. Though lacking martial valor, he treats others with generous magnanimity and enjoys considerable goodwill within his fiefs. Obsessed with the art of smithing and commercial operations, he believes that gold and stout fortifications are far more reliable than intangible knightly honor. When handling state affairs, he displays exceptional financial acumen and administrative talent, always seeking the safest path to survival amid complex feudal struggles—a conflict-averse, stability-seeking temperament that makes him seem out of place among the martial nobility of Vlandia.
Background: Peric hails from the prominent Vlandian house of dey Molarn and grew up in the bustling west-coast stronghold of Ostican. As a kinsman of Baron Hecard, he witnessed his clan's rise under King Derthert's banner from an early age. Unlike his clan elders' bloody pursuit of power, Peric has poured his energies into the construction and trade of Ostican. Well-versed in engineering and medicine, he personally oversaw the reinforcement of his clan's fortifications and amassed substantial wealth for his house through keen commercial instincts. Amid the turbulent politics of Vlandia, he has remained loyal to Derthert, yet he would much rather stay behind an anvil and a ledger than mount a warhorse and charge into battle. To him, preserving the prosperity of Clan dey Molarn in Ostican is far more important than risking everything on territorial expansion.
